interview.secured: The app never explained "Day secured" to me on the screens I saw, so I can only guess it means today's task is marked done, but I can't say for sure.
interview.freeze: The app never showed me what a freeze is, so I don't know; I never saw that word explained.
interview.selfReported: On the Read task screen, it means I just tell the app I did it and it marks today done, with no photo, camera, time window, or location check, and my challenge shows it without a photo.
interview.tomorrow: 6 - The challenge with Dana is simple and the Done button is easy, but the walk challenge having a Read task is confusing and a few terms were never explained.

goals.text: The invite opened Dana's challenge: accept it and join. Then find Dana's proof post on the challenge or in the feed. Like it, double-tap the photo, and leave a one-line comment. Then tap Dana's name to open the profile.
